decisions.statement: The game's own menu functions are wrapped rather than replaced.
A custom entry is drawn from a control pool this library owns.
Context menu callbacks fire in category order from early to late.
A sub-menu opens once the mouse has rested on its parent row.
The player and social list menus are hooked only on the keyboard interface.
A caller reaches this library through a game global rather than an import.

definition: an addon library adding sub-menus, dividers and headers to the game's context menus
